mapper.sql: SELECT A.SMSTR_CHRT_ID , A.ORG_ID , A.DGRS_YR , A.DGRS_SMSTR_CHRT , A.SMSTR_CHRT_GBNCD , A.SMSTR_CHRT_TYCD , A.SMSTR_CHRT_STSCD , A.SMSTR_CHRT_DATA_LNKGYN , A.SMSTR_CHRTNM , A.SMSTR_CHRT_OP_SDTTM , A.SMSTR_CHRT_OP_EDTTM , A.OFLN_LRN_MNGYN , A.ATNDLC_APLY_SDTTM , A.ATNDLC_APLY_EDTTM , A.ATNDLC_MOD_SDTTM , A.ATNDLC_MOD_EDTTM , A.ATNDLC_SDTTM , A.ATNDLC_EDTTM , A.MRK_EVL_SDTTM , A.MRK_EVL_EDTTM , A.MRK_OPEN_SDTTM , A.MRK_OPEN_EDTTM , A.MBL_ATNDC_USEYN , A.NOW_SMSTRYN , A.RVW_EDTTM , A.PROF_ACCSS_PBL_SDTTM , A.RGTR_ID , A.REG_DTTM , A.MDFR_ID , A.MOD_DTTM , A.SMSTR_CHRT_LCTR_SDTTM , A.SMSTR_CHRT_LCTR_EDTTM , A.SMSTR_CHRT_LATE_RECG_DTTM FROM TB_LMS_SMSTR_CHRT A

/* SQL ID : SemesterDAO.listSmstrChrtSchdlWkno 설 명 : 학기기수 일정 주차 목록 조회 */
SELECT A.SMSTR_CHRT_SCHDL_ID , A.SMSTR_CHRT_ID , A.SCHDL_WKNO , A.TOC_SEQNO AS TOC_SEQ , A.SMSTR_CHRT_SYMD , A.SMSTR_CHRT_EYMD , A.SMSTR_CHRT_ATNDC_RCG_SYMD , A.SMSTR_CHRT_ATNDC_RCG_EYMD , A.SCHDL_WKNONM FROM TB_LMS_SMSTR_CHRT_SCHDL A INNER JOIN TB_LMS_SMSTR_CHRT B ON B.SMSTR_CHRT_ID = A.SMSTR_CHRT_ID WHERE A.SMSTR_CHRT_ID = #{smstrChrtId} AND B.ORG_ID = #{orgId} ORDER BY NVL(A.TOC_SEQNO, A.SCHDL_WKNO), A.SCHDL_WKNO
